items.title: Bob Shoffner Interview, 1959-09-08
items.q: The interviewee identifies himself as 'Bob Schaffler' and 'Robert L. Schaffler'. The person to judge is 'Robert L. Schaffler'. There is no mention of another person by this name; the text only establishes the interviewee's own identity.

ctx.x: My name is Bob Schaffler. They called me Bob Schaffler. My name is Robert L. Schaffler, Robert Lee Schaffler. What the musician called me, Bob Schaffler. Where were you born? Just when? I was born in Bessie, Tennessee, April the 30th, 1900s. So just about 59 years old now. Yes, that's right. And my people brought me to St. Louis when I was two years old of course. I knew more about St. Louis than I knew about Bessie, Tennessee.

Did none of your folks play music? Your father or mother? No one in my family played music. Any brothers or sisters that were interested? I have no brothers or sisters. Do you remember the first music you heard? What kind of music you heard in St. Louis?
